dependency_reconstruction: Six original conditions determine actual harmonic flow, reflection and nonnegative continuous-in-time rate. Borel reflection remains valid with R0=I even though it may be discontinuous.

Integrated hazard Lambda(0)=0 with derivative lambda(Phi_t z), continuous nondecreasing on finite times, together with actual Exp1 threshold law yields existing first-wait CDF and survival. This CDF alone is already an existing producer and is not a new edge.

A genuinely new edge differentiates the finite first-wait law into density lambda(Phi_s z)*exp(-Lambda(s)), then pushes it through the deterministic Borel post-jump mark S(Phi_s z). Density needs continuous/absolutely continuous hazard, not strict increase or positive rate.

Finite marked law is a subprobability; on horizon T its mass is 1-exp(-Lambda(T))<=1. A potentially nonzero no-jump/at-infinity mass must not be silently normalized away. Flat hazards, zero rate/rank0 and firstwait=infinity are allowed.

At zero raw threshold tau=0; actual Exp1 threshold gives that event probability0. Finite positive-time endpoints have no atoms under the continuous CDF; half-open/inclusive horizon conventions must be explicitly justified.

The finite first-jump density/mark is a real ingredient of source A7 product jump-rate factors, but full A7 additionally requires fresh-clock independence/restart iteration, ordered-simplex path measurability, final survival and summability/nonexplosion. None follows from the one-step density alone.

Path reversal further AND-needs Borel measure-preserving finite endpoint maps, time-simplex reversal, density/survival identity A4, jump-rate matching A5 and bounce/flow/reversal volume preservation A6. Generator exponential route is explicitly heuristic, not an independent rigorous OR proof.

Invariance follows only after termwise finite-path reversal plus Tonelli/signed extension. Jensen/contraction AND invariance, then all-L2 continuity AND Cc-density AND bounded-test continuity. Typed probability kernel alone is optional representation, not an invariance ingredient.
Averaged ideal reference/momentum kernels and augmented-space operator, stationary event-rate bounds, cap coupling and query costs remain downstream boundary context, not new one-step consequences.
